in_hebrew.name: חורס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew word ‘חורס’ (chors), meaning ‘thicket’ or ‘enclosure’. It could be a reference to a person living in a densely wooded area or a fortified settlement.

in_greek.name: Χορτας
in_greek.long_meaning: A name derived from the Greek word ‘Χορτας’ (Chortas), meaning ‘thicket’, ‘hedge’, or ‘enclosure’. It could be a reference to a person living in a thickly wooded area or a fortified settlement.
